Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. 3 flagged, 5 cleared.
Flagged (summary_outlier):
- r07: The REGR peak is 53.09 %/h against a batch median of 0.37. The growth zone is 695 µm against 52.5 µm. The largest flank difference is -8.36 %/h against 0.55 %/h. All checks pass, but this profile has a different shape. It is not just a faster root.
- r01, r08: The largest flank difference is at 84 µm against a median of 331.5 µm (z -10.8). Its sign is reversed (-0.47 against 0.55 %/h). The REGR peak is about twice the median (0.72 against 0.37 %/h). All checks pass, but the curvature-rate pattern along the flanks has a different shape.
Cleared: r02, r03, r04, r05, r06. All checks pass, no remedies were kept, there were no roll-backs, and every summary has |z| ≤ 1.32. r05 took 4 steps but ended on default settings.
What the flagged runs have in common: all three passed every kinematic check with no remedies kept. They were caught only because their strain-rate and flank-difference profiles do not match the rest of the batch. The checks alone did not catch them.
Also note: several runs have identical checks and summaries (r01 = r08, r03 = r04, r02 = r05 = r06). This may mean the same data was entered more than once, so it is worth checking.
